errors.text: The hypothesis relocates the principal antiferromagnetic interaction to exchange across the fcc/C14 interface, whereas the target mechanism concerns antiparallel coupling between Ti and Fe/Co/Ni sublattices within the phase-specific magnetic structures.

The requested C14-dominant Fe27Co27Ni17Ti29 comparison is replaced by a nominally single-phase fcc control, so the proposed experiment cannot isolate the C14-associated transitions near 214–246 K and 183 K or establish the fcc origin of the 1084 K and 168 K transitions.
The claim that the C14 phase suppresses the orbital and spin moments specifically inside the fcc phase is not established by the cited evidence or by the target result.
